backup_restore_tests.notes: SQLite online backup API safely flushes WAL pages into the target backup database without blocking concurrent readers or writers.
In WAL mode, committed pages reside in the -wal file until a checkpoint occurs. A naive file copy of the .db file alone misses all uncheckpointed transactions and schema modifications.

backup_restore_tests.method: Restoration of both JSON state and idempotency SQLite database to an isolated new directory
backup_restore_tests.rejection_message: Order rejected: idempotency key already executed in durable registry
backup_restore_tests.notes: Restored broker preserves deduplication history and prevents key replays in a fresh operating directory.

recommendations: Never back up .idempotency.db via raw file copy while the trading daemon is active unless conn.backup() is used.
If file-based snapshots are required, execute PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) immediately prior to snapshotting.
